newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade rather slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.

Sales confirmed on 1,300 slaughter steers and 3,100 slaughter heifers Wednesday. For the week to date 69,100 head confirmed including 20,600 head or about 30 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1300 lbs 65.00.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00. Confirmed 4,400 last week 5,900 last year none Week to date 69,100 last week 74,700 last year 12,100.
